mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the same month but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such months over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL annual rate > 2.5%) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 101.0 (index 2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 101.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 129,500 thousand signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 129500 but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 570) combined with robust GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13150) indicates late-cycle economic expansion, triggering mean-reversion in equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 570 and GDPC1 > 13150 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, prompting Fed rate hikes that increase equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2.5% but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances over the last 5 years.
